text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (April 25, 2025) for 51 Brendwin Road.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (April 25, 2025) for 51 Brendwin Road, Folder Number: 19 178435 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to December 1, 2026.
